text: The Chair will discuss the 2020 schedule of meetings for the Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee of the Board of Directors of TO Live.

The Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee referred Item RY3.1 to the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live and the City Clerk with a request to work with the Chair, Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee on holding Committee meetings at City Hall and the same week as Board of Directors of TO Live meetings.
